name: Monstera
about: Monstera deliciosa is a tropical climber with broad, glossy leaves that develop splits and holes as they mature.
used_for: Grown indoors as a foliage plant. Only the fully ripe fruit is edible. Unripe fruit and other parts contain irritating calcium oxalate crystals.

name: English lavender
about: Lavandula angustifolia is an aromatic shrub with narrow silver-green leaves and spikes of purple flowers.
used_for: Dried flowers are used in sachets. Culinary-grade buds can flavor shortbread, sugar, and syrups.

name: Sweet basil
about: Ocimum basilicum is a tender aromatic herb with soft green leaves and small summer flowers.
used_for: The leaves are used fresh in pesto, tomato salads, and sauces.

name: Spearmint
about: Mentha spicata is a spreading perennial with fragrant, pointed leaves and small pale flower spikes.
used_for: Fresh leaves flavor tea, salads, and sauces.

name: Rosemary
about: Salvia rosmarinus is an evergreen Mediterranean shrub with narrow, resin-scented leaves and pale blue flowers.
used_for: The leaves season roasted vegetables, focaccia, and stews.

name: Common thyme
about: Thymus vulgaris is a low evergreen shrub with tiny aromatic leaves and pink to lilac flowers.
used_for: Fresh or dried leaves season soups, beans, and roasted vegetables.

name: Common sunflower
about: Helianthus annuus is a tall annual with large flower heads made up of many small florets.
used_for: Its mature seeds are eaten roasted or pressed for oil. The flower heads are also grown for cutting.

name: Moth orchid
about: Phalaenopsis amabilis is an epiphytic orchid with leathery leaves and long sprays of white flowers.
used_for: Grown as a flowering houseplant and used in ornamental displays.

name: Snake plant
about: Dracaena trifasciata forms upright, sword-shaped leaves with green bands.
used_for: Grown as a low-maintenance indoor foliage plant.

name: Golden pothos
about: Epipremnum aureum is a tropical climber with glossy foliage that often has golden variegation.
used_for: Its trailing stems suit hanging baskets, and its climbing stems can be trained on a support.

name: Spider plant
about: Chlorophytum comosum forms tufts of narrow leaves and produces small plantlets on arching stems.
used_for: Grown in hanging baskets. The plantlets can be rooted to start new plants.

name: Aloe vera
about: Aloe vera forms a rosette of thick, toothed leaves that store water during dry periods.
used_for: Grown in succulent collections. The clear inner gel is used in topical products. Whole leaves and the yellow latex are unsuitable for eating.

name: Mexican snowball
about: Echeveria elegans forms compact rosettes of pale blue-green leaves with a powdery surface.
used_for: Grown in shallow containers, rock gardens, and mixed succulent planters.

name: Pot marigold
about: Calendula officinalis is a short-lived garden plant with daisy-like heads in yellow and orange.
used_for: Its petals can be used as a garnish or to add color to rice and salads.

name: Garden cosmos
about: Cosmos bipinnatus is a branching annual with finely divided foliage and pink, white, or purple flower heads.
used_for: Grown for cut flowers and pollinator-friendly garden borders.

name: Chinese hibiscus
about: Hibiscus rosa-sinensis is a tropical shrub with glossy leaves and wide flowers with prominent staminal columns.
used_for: Grown as an ornamental shrub or patio plant in warm climates.

name: Lemon tree
about: Citrus × limon is an evergreen citrus tree with fragrant white flowers and acidic yellow fruits.
used_for: The juice and zest flavor dressings, drinks, and baked goods.

name: Pomegranate
about: Punica granatum is a deciduous shrub or small tree with bright flowers and round, leathery fruits.
used_for: The juicy arils are eaten fresh or used in salads, juice, and pomegranate molasses.
